    #vibrationModeTableWrap {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-strong);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-chip-muted);
      max-height: 260px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    #vibrationSpectrumWrap {
      display: none;
      margin-top: 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-strong);
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-chip-muted);
      padding: 6px 8px 4px;
    }

    #vibrationSpectrumCanvas {
      width: 100%;
      height: 128px;
      display: block;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--vm-color-surface-control) 92%, var(--vm-color-surface-raised)),
        var(--vm-color-surface-control)
      );
    }

    #vibrationSpectrumMeta {
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-helper-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-helper-weight);
      line-height: 1.2;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    #vibrationModeTable {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: var(--vm-type-data-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-data-weight);
      color: var(--text);
    }

    #vibrationModeTable th,
    #vibrationModeTable td {
      padding: 6px 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-strong);
      text-align: left;
      vertical-align: middle;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    #vibrationModeTable th {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1;
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-chip);
      color: var(--vm-color-text-label);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-section-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-section-weight);
    }

    #vibrationModeTable td:nth-child(1) {
      width: 46px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    #vibrationModeTable td:nth-child(2) {
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    #vibrationModeTable td:nth-child(4),
    #vibrationModeTable td:nth-child(5) {
      width: 120px;
      text-align: right;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
    }

    #vibrationModeTable[data-has-intensity="false"] th.vibrationIntensityCol,
    #vibrationModeTable[data-has-intensity="false"] td.vibrationIntensityCol {
      display: none;
    }

    #vibrationModeTable tr.mode-row {
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background-color 120ms ease;
    }

    #vibrationModeTable tr.mode-row:hover {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vm-color-surface-control) 70%, var(--vm-color-surface-panel));
    }

    #vibrationModeTable tr.mode-row.active {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vm-brand-accent) 18%, var(--vm-color-surface-control));
    }

    #vibrationModeTable tr.mode-row.active td {
      color: var(--vm-color-on-control);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-data-emphasis-weight);
    }

    .vibrationPlayCell {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-control);
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-control);
      color: var(--vm-color-on-control);
      font-size: var(--vm-text-lg);
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      font-family: var(--vm-font-icon);
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-body);
      line-height: 1;
      font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 20;
      box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-control);
    }

    .vibrationPlayCell:hover {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vm-brand-accent) 18%, var(--vm-color-surface-control));
    }

    #trajectoryNowPlaying,
    #vibrationNowPlaying {
      margin-top: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-status-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-status-weight);
      line-height: var(--vm-leading-body);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    #vibrationModeEmpty {
      display: none;
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-helper-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-helper-weight);
      padding: 10px 2px 2px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      :root {
        --floating-panel-top-offset: 68px;
      }
    }

    #sideHeader {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-strong);
      color: var(--text);
    }

    #sideHeader .title {
      font-size: var(--vm-type-panel-title-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-panel-title-weight);
      line-height: var(--vm-leading-tight);
    }

    #sideClose {
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-secondary);
      color: var(--vm-color-text-primary);
      border: none;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    #coordsContent {
      padding: 10px 12px;
      overflow: visible;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-data-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-data-weight);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      font-family: var(--vm-font-mono);
    }

    #coordsContent .coordsActiveLabel {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaContent {
      padding: 6px 8px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border);
      border-radius: var(--tb-radius-tight);
      color: var(--tb-text-color-primary);
      font-size: var(--tb-text-size-meta);
      max-height: 140px;
      overflow: auto;
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-panel);
      box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-sm);
      scrollbar-width: thin;
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaWrap {
      display: none;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaTitle {
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
      font-size: var(--tb-text-size-meta);
      font-weight: var(--tb-text-weight-bold);
      margin: 0 0 4px 1px;
      text-transform: none;
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaContent .meta-empty {
      color: var(--tb-text-color-meta-empty);
      font-style: italic;
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaContent table.meta-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaContent table.meta-table th,
    #toolbar #pubchemMetaContent table.meta-table td {
      padding: 3px 4px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border);
      vertical-align: top;
      word-break: break-word;
      text-align: left;
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaContent table.meta-table th {
      width: 68px;
      color: var(--tb-text-color-meta-key);
      font-weight: var(--tb-text-weight-semibold);
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaContent table.meta-table td {
      color: var(--tb-text-color-primary);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    #toolbar #pubchemMetaContent table.meta-table th + td {
      font-family: var(--vm-font-mono);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    #viewControls {
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-strong);
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-chip);
    }

    #viewControls .row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    #viewControls .row-vec {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 60px 10px 1fr 10px 1fr 10px 1fr;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    #viewControls label {
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-label-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-label-weight);
    }

    #viewControls input[type="number"] {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 3px 6px;
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-panel);
      color: var(--text);
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-strong);
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    #viewControls input[type="checkbox"] {
      vertical-align: middle;
    }

    #viewControls .axis {
      color: var(--vm-color-text-label);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-helper-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-helper-weight);
      text-align: center;
    }

    #coordsContent table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
    }

    #coordsContent th,
    #coordsContent td {
      text-align: right;
      padding: 4px 6px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-strong);
    }

    #coordsContent th {
      text-align: left;
      color: var(--vm-color-text-label);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-section-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-section-weight);
    }

    #coordsContent tbody tr[data-atom-index] {
      transition: background-color 120ms ease;
    }

    #coordsContent tbody tr[data-atom-index]:hover,
    #coordsContent tbody tr.coordsRowHovered {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vm-brand-accent) 12%, transparent);
    }

    #coordsContent .coordsCellButton {
      appearance: none;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: inherit;
      font: inherit;
      font-family: var(--vm-font-mono);
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    #coordsContent .coordsCellButton:hover {
      color: var(--vm-brand-accent);
    }

    #coordsContent .coordsCellEditor {
      width: 100%;
      box-sizing: border-box;
      padding: 2px 4px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-soft);
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-panel);
      color: var(--text);
      font: inherit;
      font-family: var(--vm-font-mono);
      text-align: inherit;
      outline: none;
    }

    #canvas {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    #fileInput {
      display: none;
    }

    #presetInput {
      display: none;
    }

    #hint {
      position: fixed;
      left: 160px;
      bottom: 24px;
      right: 12px;
      max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
      box-sizing: border-box;
      white-space: normal;
      color: var(--vm-color-on-control);
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-control);
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-control);
      border-left: 2px solid transparent;
      box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-control);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: var(--vm-font-mono);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-status-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-status-weight);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(140%);
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(6px);
      pointer-events: none;
      transition:
        opacity 260ms ease,
        transform 260ms ease,
        background-color 180ms ease,
        border-left-color 180ms ease,
        box-shadow 180ms ease;
      z-index: 31;
    }

    #hint.is-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    #hint.is-accented {
      border-left-color: var(--status-hint-accent);
      animation: hintStatusPulse 1500ms ease;
    }

    @keyframes hintStatusPulse {
      0% {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vm-brand-accent) 18%, var(--vm-color-surface-control));
        box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-control);
      }
      100% {
        background: var(--vm-color-surface-control);
        box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-control);
      }
    }

    #emptyState {
      position: fixed;
      top: 56px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 6;
      padding: 20px;
    }

    #emptyState.hidden {
      display: none;
    }

    #emptyStateCard {
      width: min(620px, 92vw);
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-card-fg);
      background: var(--vm-color-splash-card-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-splash-card-border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 22px 24px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-md);
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    #emptyStateLead {
      margin: 0 0 12px 0;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: center;
    }

    #emptyStateVersion {
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-version);
    }

    #emptyStateDropZone {
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-splash-drop-border);
      background: var(--vm-color-splash-drop-bg);
      box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-sm);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 16px 14px;
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-drop-fg);
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-strong);
      font-size: clamp(15px, 1.8vw, 18px);
    }

    #emptyStateDropZone code {
      background: var(--vm-color-splash-drop-code-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-splash-drop-code-border);
      border-radius: 5px;
      padding: 1px 5px;
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-drop-code-fg);
      font-size: var(--vm-text-base);
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-emphasis);
      font-family: var(--vm-font-mono);
    }

    kbd {
      font-family: var(--vm-font-mono);
    }

    #emptyStateDropIcon {
      display: block;
      font-size: 30px;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-drop-icon);
    }

    #emptyStatePrimaryAction {
      margin-top: 14px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    #emptyStateOpenBtn {
      appearance: none;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      min-width: 160px;
      background: var(--vm-color-splash-cta-bg);
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-cta-fg);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-heading);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: filter 150ms ease;
    }

    #emptyStateOpenBtn:hover {
      filter: brightness(1.05);
    }

    #emptyStateSecondary {
      margin-top: 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      justify-content: center;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    #emptyStateSecondary button {
      appearance: none;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-link);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: var(--vm-text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-strong);
      padding: 2px 4px;
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 2px;
    }

    #emptyStateMeta {
      margin-top: 12px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: var(--vm-text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-emphasis);
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-meta);
    }

    #emptyStateWhatsNew {
      margin-top: 14px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    #emptyStateWhatsNewSummary {
      width: fit-content;
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-link);
      font-size: var(--vm-text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-heading);
      cursor: pointer;
      list-style: none;
      user-select: none;
    }

    #emptyStateWhatsNewSummary::-webkit-details-marker {
      display: none;
    }

    #emptyStateWhatsNewSummary::after {
      content: 'open_in_new';
      font-family: var(--vm-font-icon);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-body);
      line-height: 1;
      font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 20;
    }

    #emptyStateWhatsNew[open] #emptyStateWhatsNewSummary::after {
      content: 'expand_less';
    }

    #emptyStateWhatsNewPanel {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(120, 139, 168, 0.22);
      background: rgba(86, 103, 129, 0.08);
    }

    .emptyStateWhatsNewLead {
      font-size: var(--vm-text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--vm-font-weight-heading);
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-meta);
    }

    #emptyStateWhatsNewList {
      margin: 0;
      padding-left: 16px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 5px;
      color: var(--vm-color-splash-card-fg);
      font-size: var(--vm-text-xs);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    #elementColorOverlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52);
      z-index: 60;
    }

    #elementColorModal {
      width: min(920px, 96vw);
      max-height: 86vh;
      overflow: auto;
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-raised);
      color: var(--vm-color-on-raised);
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-lg);
      padding: 10px 12px 12px;
    }

    #elementColorHead {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    #elementColorHead .title {
      font-size: var(--vm-type-panel-title-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-panel-title-weight);
      line-height: var(--vm-leading-tight);
    }

    #elementColorPickerRow {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
    }

    #elementColorName {
      min-width: 180px;
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-label-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-data-emphasis-weight);
    }

    #periodicTableViewport {
      width: 100%;
      height: 420px;
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-panel-border-strong);
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%, var(--vm-color-periodic-grad-a) 0%, var(--vm-color-periodic-grad-b) 52%, var(--vm-color-periodic-grad-c) 100%);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    #periodicTableCanvas {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
      cursor: default;
    }

    .pt-legend {
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: var(--vm-color-text-secondary);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-helper-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-helper-weight);
    }

    /* --- Workspace Sidebar (Figma-like left dock) --- */
    body {
      --workspace-sidebar-width: 320px;
      --workspace-left-offset: var(--workspace-sidebar-width);
      --vibration-panel-bottom-clearance: 52px;
      --toolbar-divider: var(--vm-color-toolbar-divider);
      /* Toolbar typography tokens */
      --tb-font-family: var(--vm-font-sans);
      --tb-text-size-title: var(--vm-type-panel-title-size);
      --tb-text-size-ui: var(--vm-type-body-size);
      --tb-text-size-label: var(--vm-type-label-size);
      --tb-text-size-meta: var(--vm-type-helper-size);
      --tb-text-weight-regular: var(--vm-type-body-weight);
      --tb-text-weight-semibold: var(--vm-type-panel-title-weight);
      --tb-text-weight-bold: var(--vm-type-data-emphasis-weight);
      --tb-text-color-primary: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-primary);
      --tb-text-color-strong: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-strong);
      --tb-text-color-subtle: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-subtle);
      --tb-text-color-emphasis: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-emphasis);
      --tb-text-color-icon: var(--vm-color-toolbar-icon-strong);
      --tb-text-color-tooltip: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-tooltip);
      --tb-text-color-meta-key: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-meta-key);
      --tb-text-color-meta-empty: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-meta-empty);
      --tb-text-color-chip: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-chip);
      --tb-text-color-chip-muted: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-chip-muted);
      --tb-text-color-code: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-code);
      --tb-text-color-inverse: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-inverse);
      --tb-radius-tight: 3px;
      --toolbar-font-size: var(--tb-text-size-ui);
      --toolbar-font-weight: var(--tb-text-weight-semibold);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-height: 23px;
      --toolbar-mode-tab-radius: var(--tb-radius-tight);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-bg: var(--vm-color-toolbar-control-bg);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-bg-hover: var(--vm-color-toolbar-control-bg-hover);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-bg-active: var(--vm-color-toolbar-control-bg);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-fg: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tab-fg);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-fg-hover: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tab-fg-hover);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-fg-active: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tab-fg-active);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-accent: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tab-accent);
      --tb-surface-base: var(--vm-color-surface-base);
      --tb-surface-emphasis: var(--vm-color-toolbar-control-bg);
      --tb-surface-emphasis-hover: var(--vm-color-toolbar-control-bg-hover);
      --tb-surface-button: var(--vm-color-toolbar-button-bg);
      --tb-surface-input: var(--vm-color-toolbar-input-bg);
      --tb-border-input: var(--vm-color-toolbar-input-border);
      --tb-tooltip-bg: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tooltip-bg);
      --tb-section-divider: var(--vm-color-toolbar-section-divider);
      --tb-color-accent: var(--vm-color-toolbar-action);
      --tb-color-accent-outline: var(--vm-color-toolbar-action-outline);
      --tb-swatch-outline: rgba(40, 44, 52, 0.22);
    }

    body.sidebar-collapsed {
      --workspace-left-offset: 0px;
      --vibration-panel-bottom-clearance: 86px;
    }

    #toolbar {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0 auto 0 0;
      width: var(--workspace-sidebar-width);

    #hint {
      position: fixed;
      left: 160px;
      bottom: 24px;
      right: 12px;
      max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
      box-sizing: border-box;
      white-space: normal;
      color: var(--vm-color-on-control);
      background: var(--vm-color-surface-control);
      border: 1px solid var(--vm-color-border-control);
      border-left: 2px solid transparent;
      box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-control);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: var(--vm-font-mono);
      font-size: var(--vm-type-status-size);
      font-weight: var(--vm-type-status-weight);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(140%);
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(6px);
      pointer-events: none;
      transition:
        opacity 260ms ease,
        transform 260ms ease,
        background-color 180ms ease,
        border-left-color 180ms ease,
        box-shadow 180ms ease;
      z-index: 31;
    }

    #hint.is-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    #hint.is-accented {
      border-left-color: var(--status-hint-accent);
      animation: hintStatusPulse 1500ms ease;
    }

    @keyframes hintStatusPulse {
      0% {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--vm-brand-accent) 18%, var(--vm-color-surface-control));
        box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-control);
      }
      100% {
        background: var(--vm-color-surface-control);
        box-shadow: var(--vm-shadow-control);
      }
    }

    /* --- Workspace Sidebar (Figma-like left dock) --- */
    body {
      --workspace-sidebar-width: 320px;
      --workspace-left-offset: var(--workspace-sidebar-width);
      --vibration-panel-bottom-clearance: 52px;
      --toolbar-divider: var(--vm-color-toolbar-divider);

      --tb-text-size-meta: var(--vm-type-helper-size);
      --tb-text-weight-regular: var(--vm-type-body-weight);
      --tb-text-weight-semibold: var(--vm-type-panel-title-weight);
      --tb-text-weight-bold: var(--vm-type-data-emphasis-weight);

      --tb-text-color-strong: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-strong);
      --tb-text-color-subtle: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-subtle);
      --tb-text-color-emphasis: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-emphasis);
      --tb-text-color-icon: var(--vm-color-toolbar-icon-strong);
      --tb-text-color-tooltip: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-tooltip);
      --tb-text-color-meta-key: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-meta-key);
      --tb-text-color-meta-empty: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-meta-empty);
      --tb-text-color-chip: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-chip);
      --tb-text-color-chip-muted: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-chip-muted);
      --tb-text-color-code: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-code);
      --tb-text-color-inverse: var(--vm-color-toolbar-text-inverse);
      --tb-radius-tight: 3px;
      --toolbar-font-size: var(--tb-text-size-ui);
      --toolbar-font-weight: var(--tb-text-weight-semibold);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-height: 23px;
      --toolbar-mode-tab-radius: var(--tb-radius-tight);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-bg: var(--vm-color-toolbar-control-bg);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-bg-hover: var(--vm-color-toolbar-control-bg-hover);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-bg-active: var(--vm-color-toolbar-control-bg);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-fg: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tab-fg);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-fg-hover: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tab-fg-hover);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-fg-active: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tab-fg-active);
      --toolbar-mode-tab-accent: var(--vm-color-toolbar-tab-accent);
